tweets.text:
Today SpaceX launched ~45tons of Starlink mass simulators on Starship Flight 12, the highest payload tonnage to space since Saturn V's Skylab (77t) in 1973.

This is a huge milestone for spaceflight and cannot be ignored, the future of space and this program is so bright!!

SpaceX has just launched and deployed ~45 tons to space.

This was one of the heaviest payloads since Polyus launched by Energia in 1987 and Skylab launched by Saturn V in 1973!








SpaceX (@SpaceX)

Starship has successfully deployed our modified @Starlink satellites and simulators
